limitations: Sampled scan pairs from one public drive; no reference extrinsic or accuracy claim.

All convergence, degeneracy and diagnostic outputs remain visible; timing success means execution/parity rather than calibration recovery.
1 shared-host timing repetitions; process/library/OS caches persist; not independent accuracy trials, confidence or a portable speed guarantee.
Bootstrap fields are schema summaries only; consult every retained trial.

Early tool pilot on uncommitted source; original checkout HEAD: 9fe0d4f. Recorded source-byte hashes are preserved. Two failures are solely the sequential control recording multi_start_workers=1 in the plane solver options. All other numerical fields match final cases; raw payloads/statuses/digests stay unchanged. The final tool passes the same plane options to every method.

Local path prefixes are normalized to ${WORKSPACE_ROOT} and ${DATASET_ROOT}. Every complete payload and original input/config/output digest is unchanged. Output digests bind canonical numerical JSON, not a standalone result file.
